rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own residential structure (shingles on back porch overhang) with no third-party involvement or vehicle damage.
claim_summary: Policyholder Jordan Lee (POL-1006) reports wind damage to back porch overhang that blew off four shingles last weekend. Estimated repair cost is $400 with no interior water intrusion or additional damage. Straightforward minor property damage claim ready for roofer assessment.

case_facts.description: wind damage, four shingles blown off
